evidence_class_note: Observations of a third party website on one date. Not synthetic, not PoB-derived, not a gameplay measurement. A status recorded here describes what one client saw once.

inspection.client_user_agent_note: The tool does not expose the user agent it sends. Any user-agent dependent behaviour below is therefore unattributed.
inspection.rendering: server response converted to Markdown by the tool; client-side JavaScript is not executed

bounds.note: Seven single requests to paths named in robots.txt, in docs/specs/research.md or in a public search result. No path was guessed and no listing was walked. One further request went to pobb.in/robots.txt, a different host, to check the linked export host's policy.

robots.reading: The published robots policy permits /poe-2/ and does not name any automation agent. The English build paths this project needs are not disallowed.

terms.note: The terms page refused this client, so no clause was read. Nothing about automated access, redistribution or commercial use is established for this provider.

access.rationale: robots.txt permits the build paths, but every HTML path requested returned HTTP 403 to this client while robots.txt itself returned 200. The block is at the edge and is client dependent, not a published prohibition. No automated access method is confirmed. Manual capture and the provider's own build-file download remain candidates because docs/specs/research.md records a browser reaching the same pages on 2026-10-04.

listing_metadata.note: The listing page refused this client. Titles, patch labels, authors and update dates appear in a public search index, which is an index of the provider, not an acquisition route for this project.

full_build_data.note: Not confirmed by any observation. A public search result reports that guides carry a Build Planner Export download and a pobb.in link. Neither was retrieved, so no item list and no passive tree was seen in any format. Browser-visible guide text would not have established this either.

explanatory_prose.note: docs/specs/research.md records that a guide page carried substantial content on 2026-10-04 through a different browser. This inspection retrieved none of it.

fields_visible.note: Nothing in reported_not_confirmed is evidence of an extractable field. It records what a later adapter should look for.

structured_export_formats.route: a Build Planner Export section inside a guide page, reported by a public search result
a pobb.in link inside a guide page, reported by the same search result. pobb.in is a separate host with its own policy and needs its own manifest before use.

pagination.note: The listing was never retrieved. The sitemap that robots.txt advertises also refused this client, so neither a page parameter nor a sitemap enumeration was observed.

authentication.note: No login, token or cookie was used. The 403 carried no authentication challenge that this tool reported.

provider_declared.note: None published in robots.txt. The terms page was unreadable.

recommended_adapter_path.summary: No automatic adapter. Accept explicit local input only: a build file or a PoB code the operator exports from a guide, imported as local_file, plus manual_capture of a single named page when a reviewer supplies it.

store one explicitly named captured page as a raw SourceDocument

evidence.observation: HTTP 200. Single group for User-agent: *, Allow: /, with the disallow list recorded above and one sitemap line. No agent-specific group.
HTTP 403. No body returned to the client.
HTTP 403. No body returned to the client. Confirms the refusal is not a trailing-slash artefact.
HTTP 403. This is the guide docs/specs/research.md recorded as accessible on 2026-10-04.
HTTP 403. The terms of use were not read.
HTTP 403, although robots.txt advertises this exact URL.

A public web search over mobalytics.gg returned guide titles carrying a 0.5.5 patch label, author names, update dates in October 2026, class listing paths and author profile paths, plus a statement that guides offer a Build Planner Export download and a pobb.in link. This is a third-party index of the provider. It is not an acquisition route and it does not show any item or tree data.

HTTP 200. User-agent: * with Disallow: /api/, /pob/, /*/raw$, /*/json$, /*/xml$, /login, /oauth2/*. The raw build route a Mobalytics guide would link to is disallowed to crawlers on that host. pobb.in needs its own manifest before any use.

The recorded research inspection reached the listing and one guide page in a browser and saw patch and type labels, favourites metadata and substantial guide content. It did not establish bulk export, pagination completeness or structured item and tree data.
HTTP 403. The provider's own page describing build-file downloads was not read.
